title: 25-34 year olds living with a spouse, 1968 vs 2018 (percent)

source.name: America's Families and Living Arrangements (Census figures, compiled historical comparison)

notes: Share of 25-34 year olds living with a spouse fell from about 81.5% in 1968 to about 40.3% in 2018, while the share living with an unmarried partner rose from about 0.2% to 14.8% over the same period.
